canonical_backbone_8_levels.name: DOCUMENTED
canonical_backbone_8_levels.description: Claim backed by referenced documentation & hash.

canonical_backbone_8_levels.name: IMPLEMENTED
canonical_backbone_8_levels.description: Artifact exists in build/deployment with manifest binding.

canonical_backbone_8_levels.name: RUNNING
canonical_backbone_8_levels.description: Artifact observed executing in a runtime with execution trace.

canonical_backbone_8_levels.name: OBSERVED
canonical_backbone_8_levels.description: Execution result recorded by an observer identity.

canonical_backbone_8_levels.name: VERIFIED
canonical_backbone_8_levels.description: Independent verification of result vs expected semantics by designated verifier.

canonical_backbone_8_levels.name: REPRODUCED
canonical_backbone_8_levels.description: Independent party re-executed with matching results (>=1 independent run).

canonical_backbone_8_levels.name: PROVEN
canonical_backbone_8_levels.description: REPRODUCED + external attestation + Shura governance approval (never automatic).

special_states.HOLD: Evaluation pending or gated; NOT a failure
special_states.SANDBOX: Isolated simulation; never promoted without leaving sandbox
